caption: The drawing consists of a detailed, monochromatic pencil sketch of a candlestick, which occupies the central portion of the image. The candlestick has a wide, rounded base that tapers upward in a series of smooth, curved segments before flaring out slightly just beneath the candle holder at the top. Below the main drawing, three additional technical views are presented: on the left is a top-down circular view of the base with two concentric circles, dimensions marked as 2 1/4; in the center is a front elevation view with the overall height marked as 10 units and the base and top diameters noted as 4 3/4 and 2 1/4 respectively; on the right is a side or profile view of the candle-holding area at the top, also dimensioned. The background is a plain, light beige color, and all lines, shading, and dimension markings are rendered in gray pencil. The word "-MEYERS-" is written beside the main view, and "SCALE 1-IN" is indicated beneath the technical views.
title: Candlestick
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
